overview.description: One paragraph overview of the contents of the file as a whole

name.description: Standard modern English name of the place

variants.description: Spellings of this place exactly as they appear in the text, including the standard name if it appears

name.description: Full name as best identified, e.g. 'Joseph C. Grew'

role.description: Role or position, if stated, e.g. 'U.S. Ambassador to Japan'

variants.description: Forms of the name exactly as they appear in the text, e.g. 'GREW', 'Mr. Grew'

keywords.description: 8-15 keywords for the file as a whole

title.description: Short identifying title, e.g. 'Telegram from Grew (Tokyo) on cabinet crisis'

doc_type.description: telegram, despatch, memorandum, letter, cross-reference sheet, report, clipping, etc.

date.description: Date of the sub-file as YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY; empty if none

about.description: One sentence on what the sub-file is about

summary.description: A summary of the sub-file, 2-5 sentences

interest.description: A few sentences on what is interesting, unique or useful about this document and its sub-files
